d:
PM Narendra Modi ne vaishali men apne sanbodhan ke dauran Nitish Kumar ke netritv ki jamkar tariph ki aur Samrat Choudhary sarkar ke kamkaj ka jikr kiya. PM Modi ne NDA sarkar ke ek sal ka Report Card pesh karte hue bihar men hue vikas karyon, nivesh, rojgar aur garib kalyan ki yojnaon ko ginaya. vahin kangres aur vipaksh par nishana sadhte hue PM Modi ne purane shasankal aur maujuda vikas ki tulna ki. dekhie puri spich.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
Welcome to Bihar Tak
